description: Get a live price quote for a Premier Letters order. Pass char_count (or letter_count for a rough estimate) plus optional mailing_option and paper_type to get a per-piece and total price, in cents. No account needed. Orders under 5 pieces carry a $0.99 per-piece handling fee (included in total_cents), waived when paid from a prepaid balance. Pass output_mode (printed_bw / printed_color) to quote a printed letter body instead of a pen-written one, and envelope_output_mode to quote a printed envelope.

char_count.description: Length of the letter message in characters. Longer letters cost more (character meter).

envelope_output_mode.description: Omit (or null) for a hand-addressed envelope, the default. printed_bw / printed_color print the envelope instead.

letter_count.description: Number of recipients / pieces. Defaults to 1.

mailing_option.description: Delivery option. Defaults to "we_mail" (we write, stamp, and mail it for you).

output_mode.description: Defaults to "handwritten". printed_bw / printed_color print the letter body instead of pen-writing it; the envelope stays hand-addressed unless envelope_output_mode is set.

product_type.description: Product type (letter, card, postcard, etc). Informational only — does not change pricing components beyond envelope inclusion.

name: get_pricing
